prompt_text: What are the best pest control companies in the Midwest US (Illinois, Ohio, Michigan)?
response_text:
When seeking top pest control services in the Midwest, particularly in Illinois, Ohio, and Michigan, several reputable companies stand out:

**Illinois:**

- **Orkin Pest Control**: With a strong presence in Chicago, Orkin is recognized for its comprehensive pest management services and has received positive customer feedback. ([consumeraffairs.com](https://www.consumeraffairs.com/homeowners/pest-control-chicago.html?utm_source=openai))

- **Terminix**: Operating across Illinois, Terminix offers a range of pest control solutions, including termite and mosquito treatments, backed by decades of experience. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Terminix?utm_source=openai))

**Ohio:**

- **Frame's Pest Control, Inc.**: Serving Northern Ohio and Southeastern Michigan since 1972, Frame's offers comprehensive pest control services with flexible scheduling, including same-day and Saturday appointments. ([framespestcontrol.com](https://www.framespestcontrol.com/?utm_source=openai))

- **Delving Pest Control**: Specializing in discreet and effective pest control solutions, Delving serves Northwest Ohio and Southeastern Michigan, offering both one-time treatments and ongoing prevention plans without requiring contracts. ([delvingpest.com](https://www.delvingpest.com/?utm_source=openai))

**Michigan:**

- **Rose Pest Solutions**: A family-owned company with over 160 years of experience, Rose Pest Solutions serves Michigan, Ohio, and Indiana, providing reliable pest control services with a high customer satisfaction rating. ([rosepestsolutions.com](https://www.rosepestsolutions.com/?utm_source=openai))

- **Abell Pest Control**: Offering services across Michigan, Abell provides year-round pest protection for both residential and commercial properties, with a commitment to customer satisfaction. ([abellpestcontrol.com](https://www.abellpestcontrol.com/en-us/locations/michigan?utm_source=openai))

When selecting a pest control provider, consider factors such as the company's experience, range of services, customer reviews, and any guarantees offered. It's advisable to contact these companies directly to discuss your specific needs and obtain quotes.
